title: Management GUI
items: How do you access the management GUI?
Open a supported web browser and enter the management IP address
以支援的瀏覽器開啟 Management IP 即可存取 Management GUI。
How does the main navigation menu behave in the GUI?
It automatically shrinks or expands based on browser width and can be toggled manually
It can only be changed in settings
主導覽選單依瀏覽器寬度自動縮放；展開模式時可用切換按鈕手動縮放。
How can you select multiple objects in GUI tables?
Use the Ctrl key, then right-click to display the actions menu
以 Ctrl 多選物件，再按右鍵顯示動作選單。
How can you add or remove columns from a GUI table?
在任一欄位標題按右鍵，即可新增或移除欄位。
What are preset options in the GUI?
Preestablished configuration options with commonly used parameters, such as when creating volumes
Preset Options 內含常用參數，例如建立 Volume 時可直接選用以節省時間。
How can you get help for a specific field in the GUI?
Hover over the question mark icon near the object
將滑鼠移到物件旁的問號圖示即可顯示說明；面板說明可點 Need Help 或右上角 Help。
Which object type is supported in global search results?
Global Search 支援 Partition、Volume、Volume Group、Snapshot、Host、Host Port、Host Cluster、FC Port 與 IP Address。
Which object type is NOT listed as supported by global search?
Global Search 的支援清單不包含 Storage Pool。
Which browsers does the management GUI support?
Firefox, Firefox ESR, Microsoft Edge, and Google Chrome
GUI 支援 HTML5 相容的 Firefox、Firefox ESR、Edge 與 Chrome。
What is the minimum browser viewport for the management GUI?
GUI 最小視窗為 1024 x 768，小於此尺寸會影響資料可讀性。
Which browser settings does the GUI require?
JavaScript, cookies, and file download enabled
GUI 需啟用 JavaScript、Cookies 與 File Download。
Which additional browser setting is required only for Mozilla Firefox?
Firefox 需停用或取代 Context Menu (右鍵選單)。
What happens if you use a browser version higher than the certified levels and the issue cannot be re-created?
Support might ask you to re-create the problem on a certified browser version
高於認證版本的瀏覽器仍受理，但若無法重現，Support 可能要求在認證版本上重現問題。
What is the primary tool used to service the system?
Management GUI 是服務系統的主要工具，懷疑有問題時應先用 GUI 診斷與處理。
Which panel provides access to all problems that exist on the system?
Monitoring > Events 提供系統所有問題的存取入口。
Which filter displays the most important events that need to be resolved?
使用 Recommended Actions 篩選，顯示最需要處理的 Event。
What is the default filter on the Events page?
Events 頁預設篩選為 Recommended action，依優先序列出需處理且有 Fix Procedure 的 Alert。
Which filter shows all events regardless of whether they are fixed?
Show all 顯示所有 Event，不論是否已修復。
Within what period must some events accumulate a certain count to be shown as unfixed, otherwise marked Expired?
部分 Event 需在 25 小時內累積一定次數才顯示為 Unfixed，否則標示為 Expired。
When sorting events by error code, which is the most severe?
依 Error Code 排序時，編號最小者最嚴重。
Analyze the system, suggest and perform actions, and verify the problem is resolved
Fix Procedure 分析系統、提供建議並逐步引導，必要時自動處理，最後確認問題已解決。
Why should fix procedures be used for both configuration problems and hardware failures?
They ensure required changes do not make volumes inaccessible to hosts
They are faster than the CLI
Fix Procedure 會分析系統，確保必要變更不會讓 Host 無法存取 Volume，並自動做必要的設定變更。
Even when a fault appears obvious, such as a failed drive, where should you start?
即使故障看似明顯，也一律從 Recommended Actions 開始，Fix Procedure 會一併完成必要的重新設定。
In which order should alerts be fixed?
In the displayed order; other alerts often disappear after more severe ones are resolved
依顯示順序修復；較嚴重的問題解決後，其他 Alert 常會自動消失。
A volume shows offline. What is usually the cause?
Another object is offline, such as an MDisk in the pool
Volume Offline 通常是其他 Object 離線 (例如 Pool 內的 MDisk)，Alert 會出現在 MDisk，修復後 Volume 就恢復。
After the system is created, when should hardware components be removed?
Only when a fix procedure directs you
建立系統後，只在 Fix Procedure 指示時才移除硬體元件，否則可能造成資料無法存取或遺失。
What is required on the nodes to connect to the management GUI?
At least one node must be active
All nodes must be in service state
No nodes need to be active
至少要有一個 Node 為 active；全部是 candidate 代表沒有系統可連。
Which port on each node canister must be connected and working for GUI access?
確認每個 Node Canister 的 Port 1 已接上 Ethernet 並運作。
If the management IP is incorrect, how can you temporarily open the GUI?
Use the configuration node's service address followed by /gui
可用 Service Assistant 或 Technician Port 查看，並暫時以 Configuration Node 的 Service Address 加 /gui 開啟 GUI。
Which command corrects the system IP address?
可在 Settings > Network 修改，或用 `chsystemip` 修正系統 IP。
If the remote authentication server is unavailable, which account can still log in?
superuser, because it always authenticates locally
遠端驗證伺服器無法使用時，仍可用 superuser 登入，因它一律在本機驗證。
If the GUI displays incorrectly, what should you check first?
That you are using a supported browser
GUI 或 Service Assistant 顯示不正常時，先確認使用支援的 Browser。
When Storage Insights registration cannot find the tenant, what is one thing to check?
That the IBM ID has no leading or trailing spaces
That the host is in a cluster
確認 IBM ID 前後沒有空白、Browser 可連網且能存取 Storage Insights Endpoint，並確認隱私保護、Firewall 或 Proxy 沒有阻擋。
Does the CLI provide fix procedures?
No; use it only when you need settings not available in the GUI
Yes, the same as the GUI
CLI 不提供 Fix Procedure，只在需要 GUI 沒有的設定時使用。
Which views are entry points for checking status?
Monitoring > System, Pools > MDisks by Pools, Volumes > Volumes, and Monitoring > Events
狀態檢查入口包括 Monitoring > System、Pools > MDisks by Pools、Volumes > Volumes 與 Monitoring > Events。
What actions are available for events in the Recommended action filter?
Run Fix Procedure and View Properties
Recommended action 篩選可執行 Run Fix Procedure 與 View Properties。
With the Unfixed alerts filter, what can you do with alerts that have an error code?
Run a fix procedure or mark them as fixed
Unfixed alerts 可對有 Error Code 的 Alert 執行 Fix Procedure、標為 Fixed、依時間篩選與 View Properties。
What should you do first if you suspect a problem with the system?
Use the management GUI to diagnose and resolve it
懷疑有問題時，應先使用 Management GUI 診斷與處理。
What should you do if you cannot ping the management IP?
Check routing, firewall, gateway, and subnet settings
Ping Management IP 失敗時，檢查路由、Firewall 與 Gateway、Subnet 設定。
How does filtering work on GUI tables with columns?
Display only items that include text you specify
可用篩選功能只顯示包含指定文字的項目，並可點擊欄位標題排序。
What does panel-specific help in the GUI use?
The Need Help link or the Help link in the upper-right corner
面板專屬說明可點 Need Help，或使用 GUI 右上角的 Help 連結。
Where should you look for certificate-expired or TLS errors when connecting to the GUI?
Follow the security troubleshooting for certificates and TLS
憑證過期與 TLS 錯誤的處理，依 Security 章節的疑難排解步驟。
What does the Unfixed messages and alerts filter display?
Unfixed messages and alerts 顯示尚未修復的 Alert 與 Message。
What happens to the status of an alert after the fix procedure completes?
It is deleted from the log
It is sent to IBM automatically
Fix Procedure 會盡量自動完成分析、更換零件、驗證並將 Event 標為 Fixed。
Who can resolve a forgotten password for a non-superuser local account?
An administrator, by verifying the account and resetting the password
非 superuser 帳號無法登入時，請管理員確認帳號並重設密碼。
Which statement about using the GUI for monitoring is correct?
Regularly monitor system status with the GUI
Use the GUI only during installation
Monitoring is done only by IBM
官方建議定期以 Management GUI 監控系統狀態。
What should you verify using GUI views?
The status of the system, hardware, physical storage, and volumes
使用 GUI 的各檢視確認系統、硬體裝置、實體儲存與 Volume 的狀態。
When is a fix procedure available for an alert?
When there is a service error code for the alert
Alert 有 Service Error Code 時，可執行 Fix Procedure 協助處理。
Which tool should you use if neither the GUI nor its IP is reachable and you need node details?
The service assistant or technician port
IP 設定不正確或 GUI 無法連線時，可用 Service Assistant 或 Technician Port 查看。
What should you check on nodes if no system is available to connect to?
Whether all nodes are candidate, meaning no system exists
若全部 Node 都是 candidate，代表目前沒有系統可以連線。
